name: Kingmaker Foods
old_description: We use our innovative state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities to produce safe, quality, fresh food products with consistent taste and innovative flavors. With a commitment to making the finest products available to grow our customer’s brands; we source the best possible ingredients from around the world to those available in our backyard. With some of the most experienced industry professionals, the Kingmaker Foods team brings a unique knowledge and problem solving mentality that allows us to take on challenges that others cannot.
about:
Kingmaker Foods operates a food manufacturing facility at 7698 Zionsville Road in Indianapolis, Indiana. The company runs a state-of-the-art plant focused on producing safe, quality fresh food products with consistent taste and innovative flavors.

The facility provides liquid and dry processing capabilities, offering scalable turnkey solutions for brands that need to produce and package liquid or dry food products at large scale. Its services span recipe development, packaging design, commercialization, shelf-life testing, nutrition labeling, and food safety and regulatory compliance. The plant is SQF Level 3 certified and GFSI-certified under the SQF code, with on-site labs and built-in quality controls. Operations comply with FDA regulations, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) plans.

Kingmaker Foods serves food brands and companies seeking contract manufacturing for liquid and dry products. Its customers include businesses that require ingredient sourcing, product development, and packaging development support.

The company emphasizes innovation, a 99% production service level, quick turnaround on time-sensitive projects, and flexibility in packaging and fill requirements. It states that its experienced team and problem-solving mentality allow it to take on challenges that others cannot.
